answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using hardware enclave attestation. Each node docks at the network wharf to submit a cryptographic pearl of measurements signed by secure silicon. This pins registration to a physical hardware ledge, forcing adversaries to purchase scarce, certified microchips per identity instead of instantiating virtual clones. However, microarchitectural side-channel attacks can compromise private endorsement keys, allowing adversaries to forge valid credentials.
